neighbours.label: A list of opening pieces after their set-phrase lead-in: ' Ak' after 'uses' (Akismet), ' Cro' after 'Betty' (Crocker), ' вос' after 'суббота и' (воскресенье); the same pieces after a weaker lead-in, and other words in these slots, stay lower.

short: ' Ak', ' Cro', ' вос' in set phrases
notes: Probes: 'uses Ak' 0.82, 'Betty Cro' 0.30-0.99 (0.30 after 'Hines or Betty'), 'и вос' 0.52-0.64, but 'called Ak' 0.22 and 'в вос' 0.13. I tried 'the first piece of a strongly predicted word' on new cases, and it failed: Zuckerberg, DiCaprio, Schwarzenegger, Gandhi all under 0.03. So this is only a list of set phrases. The output direction (' statistical', ' Stat') doesn't help.
